cases.question_original: Capacitatea de serviciu Cs a unei linii electrice aeriene simetrice, având capacităţile C12=C23=C31 =C şi neglijînd influenţa pământului, este:
cases.technical_positive: Power-line service capacitance in balanced three-phase positive sequence: Cs=3 C_ff + C_p; with C12=C23=C31=C and earth ignored C_p=0 therefore Cs=3C. Independent algebra: q1=C(V1−V2)+C(V1−V3)=3CV1 since V1+V2+V3=0.

abc_review.A: A=3C follows equation and exact stem under symmetric 3-phase regime.
abc_review.B: B=C/3 reverses transformation and fails energy/charge equivalence.
abc_review.C: C=C ignores two interphase capacitance contributions; not service capacitance.

cases.linguistic_counterexample: Incorrect G2 imported C; compare source original ANRE XLSX directly when access available. 2024 online third-party workbook view merely lists answer OPTION A, NOT an official answer key.

source_evidence.locator: section 2.3; slide/page around 28, Cs=3Cff+Cp

cases.technical_positive: For double busbars with one breaker per circuit, operation of one bus energized/cold reserve and two energized with transverse coupler hot reserve are distinct valid station states; NTE defines operative states but not universal optimal preference for this exact topology.

abc_review.A: One bus energized and other cold standby may be preferred under specific reliability or protection strategy.
abc_review.B: Both energized with transverse coupler closed can have different fault isolation implications and is not universally best.
abc_review.C: Both energized with hot-reserve coupler is defined as an operating arrangement, but no exact all-stations preference is established.

cases.linguistic_counterexample: The 2010 NTE definition of hot reserve describes breaker open / isolators closed, not a proof that C is preferred to A. G1 imported A versus G2 C is a real key conflict; keep both untouched.

source_evidence.locator: NTE009/10/00 Art10 and Art11 reserve-caldă/rece states

cases.question_original: Curentul produs într-un circuit care conţine elemente neliniare şi care este alimentat cu o tensiune sinusoidală este:

options_original.C: nesinusoidal sau sinusoidal, depinde de natura elementelor neliniare

cases.technical_positive: Nonlinearity can generate harmonic distortion from sinusoidal voltage. Presence of a nonlinear element does not prove it conducts in the given operating regime.

abc_review.A: Always nonsinusoidal is invalid if nonlinear branch remains nonconducting and a linear parallel branch carries sine current.
abc_review.B: Always sinusoidal invalid for diode rectification or cubic nonlinear response.
abc_review.C: Device and operating point affect whether total circuit current is exactly sinusoidal.

cases.linguistic_counterexample: For i(v)=av+bv^3 with b≠0 and v=Vsin(wt), sin³ yields third harmonic. For ideal blocked nonlinear branch parallel with resistor, net i(t)=V/R sin(wt).

source_evidence.locator: Ohmic versus nonohmic characteristic §9.4

cases.question_original: Dacă o tensiune electromotoare E, montată în latura AB a unei reţele pasive, produce în latura CD a reţelei un curent I, montarea t.e.m. E în latura CD va produce în latura AB:
cases.technical_positive: Reciprocal transfer equality holds for appropriate bilateral linear reciprocal networks with consistent reference directions, not passive networks in general.

abc_review.A: Reverse sign −I depends on current reference and cannot be deduced.
abc_review.B: Equality I is not guaranteed unless reciprocity theorem assumptions are met.

cases.linguistic_counterexample: A lossless passive gyrator is nonreciprocal. Under ideal two-port v1=R i2 and v2=−R i1, instantaneous power v1*i1+v2*i2=0 but cross-transfers have opposite signs. This disproves passive=>reciprocal.

source_evidence.locator: Oregon State ECE580 network components gyrator: lossless but nonreciprocal

cases.question_original: Legea lui Ohm pentru o porţiune de circuit este valabila:
cases.technical_positive: Ohm V=RI with constant R applies to ohmic conductors in DC and AC under the relevant linear model. 'Regardless of circuit nature' can include nonlinear/diode devices for which no constant R fits.

abc_review.A: DC-only wrong: ohmic AC circuits obey appropriate instantaneous V=RI.
abc_review.B: AC-only wrong: ohmic DC circuits obey V=RI.
abc_review.C: Exam-intended if nature means DC versus AC, literally false for nonohmic devices.

cases.linguistic_counterexample: OpenStax §9.4 explicit diode I/V nonlinearity; current isn't proportional to voltage; cannot assert unconditional C.

source_evidence.locator: Ohm's law §9.4 nonohmic diode counterexample

cases.question_original: Pentru materialele magnetice, relaţia dintre inducţia magnetică şi intensitatea câmpului magnetic:
cases.technical_positive: Nonlinear hysteretic B-H curves hold for many ferromagnetic materials; paramagnetic/diamagnetic media are described with linear weak susceptibility approximations.

abc_review.A: Linear relation B=µH is valid in a wide range of dia-/paramagnetic models.
abc_review.B: B equals H numerically/dimensionally invalid (tesla versus A/m).
abc_review.C: Nonlinear relation is common in ferromagnets, not all magnetic materials.

cases.linguistic_counterexample: OpenStax §12.7 uses B=(1+χ)B0 for paramagnetics, while ferromagnet µ depends on field history; original stem lacks ferromagnetic qualifier.

source_evidence.locator: OpenStax 12.7 magnetism in matter, paramagnetic χ linear; ferromagnetic domains and history

cases.question_original: Un corp conductor situat într-un câmp electric de intensitate E se încarcă cu electricitate:
cases.technical_positive: An external electric field redistributes charges in a neutral conductor: electrostatic induction/polarization.

abc_review.A: Conduction requires electrical contact/charge transfer, absent from stem.
abc_review.B: Induction is intended charge separation, but not necessarily a net charge acquired.
abc_review.C: Magnetization is magnetic phenomenon, not the electric separation asked.

cases.linguistic_counterexample: Isolated neutral metal sphere in external field stays net zero even though surface charges redistribute; net charging via induction generally requires earthing or transfer.

options_original.B: conduce numai la realizarea unor celule cu întreţinere mult simplificată;

cases.technical_positive: SF6 dielectric insulation allows compact switchgear due to high dielectric strength; historic property independent from the current legal right to commission a new SF6 cubicle.

abc_review.C: Compact switchgear is a known insulation benefit.

cases.linguistic_counterexample: Regulation EU 2024/573 Article13(9)(a) prohibits putting into operation new qualifying F-gas MV switchgear <=24kV from Jan1 2026, subject to derogations and prior-order exception; this does not negate physical advantage C.

options_original.A: doar realizarea unor întreruptoare fără pericol de incendiu;
options_original.B: realizarea unor întreruptoare cu întreţinere mult simplificată;

cases.technical_positive: SF6 as arc-breaking medium historically allows reduced routine breaker maintenance relative to oil, but not zero service or unlimited future installation.

cases.linguistic_counterexample: An SF6 insulated cubicle with vacuum interrupter is not evidence about SF6 arc breaking. EU Article13(9) covers F-gases in insulating OR breaking media; existing equipment not globally banned.
